claim: Extend lesson_9c4f8a7d21be and lesson_c8e4d29b7f31: the approved D-LG-1 split keeps structural GraphSpec, graph_id and structural lint in Core; Oramasys owns an independently hashed graph_id-bound policy and application summary. D-LG-4 Phase 1 permits explicit graph-as-tool and offline agent-as-node bridges, not a framework dependency or production egress. Durable approvals and R3/R4 remain gated.

decisions.notes: The 2026-10-09 operator approved the separate policy file/transclusion and bounded Phase 1. Orama PR #388 records active D-LG-1/D-LG-4; Core #8 and Oramasys #23 test the split. This qualifies ownership/runtime wording only, preserving prior one-scheduler, mutation and observer provenance. Policy lint is not admission, and provider-capable agents remain untrusted effects.
